description: This file defines a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' that converts status codes into human-readable labels for display purposes. It handles normalization, replaces delimiters with spaces, and converts strings to Title Case while preserving apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a human-readable label, handling null/undefined, replacing underscores/hyphens, collapsing spaces, and converting to Title Case.
